name: Kettlebell Double Push Press
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding two kettlebells in the front rack position with elbows tucked in and wrists straight.
Brace your core, keep your torso vertical, and bend your knees quickly into a shallow quarter-squat dip.
Drive explosively upward through your legs and hips, transferring that momentum straight into pressing both kettlebells overhead to full lockout.
Lower the kettlebells with control back into the rack position before dipping into the next repetition.
tips: Keep your chest upright during the dip instead of letting your hips fold forward.
Wait until your legs have driven upward before finishing the push with your arms.
